resources.string: Shows that Context Launch is watching location, Wi-Fi, charging, and Bluetooth.
High-priority notification when the target app cannot be opened directly.
A chosen app opens when location, Wi-Fi, charging, or Bluetooth conditions match.
Android blocked a background launch. Tap the notification to open the app.
Example: open music when charging on the home Wi-Fi, or open maps when the car Bluetooth connects.
Monitoring is off. Grant “Allow all the time” location so this app can keep running in the background.
Already fired; waiting until the condition clears
“%1$s” will be removed and will not fire again.
Example: open mail at the office
Every required block must match. If a block contains several conditions, any one of them is enough (OR).
Below 100 m, phone GPS is often only accurate to 30–100 m. Fixes worse than the radius are ignored.
A GPS fix counts only when its accuracy is no worse than the radius. Geofence dwell uses the system loitering delay.
Tap the map. You can still type coordinates if the map has no network.
Leaving is judged 30 m outside the radius so the boundary does not flap.
No networks. Turn location services on.

Matching uses scan results. The phone does not have to join that network. Keep Wi-Fi and location services on. On some phones, the system “Wi‑Fi scanning” setting still allows scans while Wi‑Fi is off.
The regex must match the whole SSID. Example: 7-11.*
After a launch, another match — for example walking past several 7-ELEVEN shops — will not open the app again until this time has passed. Zero uses only the leave / signal-drop re-arm.
This SSID is not visible right now
Location permission is required to read Wi-Fi signal strength
Re-arm when signal drops below %1$d dBm
Select any that should match. Leave them all off to accept every power source. Android cannot see the charger brand.
No paired devices, or Bluetooth permission is missing.

Uses the phone’s local time zone. An end time before the start crosses midnight and continues onto the next day from a selected weekday. The start minute is included and the end minute is not. Equal start and end means all day.
Start and end are the same: the whole selected day counts.

If the conditions are already true when a time window opens (already inside, Wi-Fi already above the threshold long enough, already charging, or Bluetooth already connected), the rule fires once at the window start. It does not repeat while the match continues. It arms again after you leave, the signal falls to the re-arm level, the network disappears long enough, charging or Bluetooth stops, or the window ends.
Add at least one complete condition
Pick a point or enter coordinates
The sign of the current depends on the phone maker. Watts use the absolute value. Android cannot read the charger brand or its rated wattage.
Time window opened while conditions were already true
Background launch was blocked; a notification was shown
This app has no launch activity
The app has to keep watching in the background so it can open another app while you are not looking at it. Grant the items below.
Used for the geofence and to read Wi-Fi names and signal strength. Android treats Wi-Fi scans as location.
Geofences and the foreground service still need location after the screen is closed. Choose “Allow all the time”.
Required on Android 13 and later to read nearby networks. This app does not derive a map position from Wi-Fi.
The ongoing monitor notification, and the tap-to-open fallback.
Since Android 10, a background app usually cannot open another app. This permission is what makes the direct launch work.
Makes it less likely that the monitor is frozen while the phone is idle. Some manufacturers still kill the app.
Used so a time window can be checked on time when you are already inside. Without it, the foreground service still checks, but Doze may delay it.
Fallback when a direct launch fails. Android 14 and later may ask for this separately.
Reads paired devices and whether one of them, such as a car stereo, is connected.
The system location switch must be on, or Wi-Fi names and geofences stay empty.

Xiaomi/Redmi: autostart and no battery restrictions. Samsung: Unrestricted, and remove the app from sleeping apps. OPPO/realme/vivo: allow autostart and background activity. Huawei: manage manually and enable autostart. After a force stop, reboot will not restart monitoring until you open the app again.
Reading charge state needs no extra permission. Voltage, current, and estimated watts are informational only and cannot tell home, car, and office chargers apart.
